description.en: The description of the Event-triggered Alert Rule.
The pattern of the Event-triggered Alert Rule.

description.zh: 事件过滤关键字。当事件内容包含该关键字时，自动触发报警。
description.en: The keyword for event filtering. When the event content contains this keyword, an alert is automatically triggered.

description.zh:
事件报警规则的类型。N的取值范围：1~50。取值：

- StatusNotification：故障通知。

- Exception：异常。

- Maintenance：运维。

- *：无限制。
description.en:
The type of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 50. Valid values:

- StatusNotification: fault notification.

- Exception: exception.

- Maintenance: O&M.

- \*: unlimited.

description.zh:
事件报警规则的等级。N的取值范围：1~50。取值：

- CRITICAL：严重。

- WARN：警告。

- INFO：信息。

- *：所有等级。
description.en:
The level of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 50. Valid values:

- CRITICAL: critical.

- WARN: warning.

- INFO: information.

- \*: all levels.

description.zh: 事件报警规则的名称。N的取值范围：1~50。
description.en: The name of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

description.zh:
云服务类型。N的取值范围：1~50。

>关于事件报警规则支持的云服务，请参见[DescribeSystemEventMetaList](~~114972~~)。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud service type. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

>For information about the Alibaba Cloud services supported by Event-triggered Alert Rules, see [DescribeSystemEventMetaList](~~114972~~).

description.zh:
SQL事件过滤。当事件内容满足SQL条件时，自动触发报警。
> SQL事件过滤的语法与日志服务SLS的查询语法保持一致。
description.en:
The SQL filter for events. When the event content meets the SQL condition, an alert is automatically triggered.
> The syntax of the SQL event filter is consistent with the query syntax of Simple Log Service (SLS).

description.zh: 事件报警规则的状态。N的取值范围：1~50。
description.en: The status of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

description.zh:
事件报警规则的类型。取值：

- SYSTEM：系统事件。
- CUSTOM：自定义事件。
description.en:
The type of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values:

- SYSTEM: system event.
- CUSTOM: custom event.

description.zh: 事件报警规则所属的应用分组ID。
description.en: The ID of the application group to which the Event-triggered Alert Rule belongs.
The name of the Event-triggered Alert Rule.

description.zh:
事件报警规则的状态。取值：

- ENABLED：启用。
- DISABLED：禁用。
description.en:
The status of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values:

- ENABLED: enabled.
- DISABLED: disabled.

title.zh: 创建或修改事件的报警规则
title.en: Create or modify an event-based alert rule

descriptions.zh:
如果报警规则名称不存在，则创建新的报警规则；如果报警规则名称存在，则修改已有报警规则。

本文将提供一个示例，为云服务`ecs`创建一条事件报警规则`myRuleName`。
descriptions.en:
If the Event-triggered Alert Rule name does not exist, a new alert rule is created. If the Event-triggered Alert Rule name already exists, the existing alert rule is modified.

This topic provides an example of how to create an event-based alert rule named `myRuleName` for the Alibaba Cloud service `ecs`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms put-event-rule --rule-name myRuleName --group-id 73780000 --event-type SYSTEM --description Event_alert_test --state ENABLED --event-pattern '[{"SQLFilter":"192.168.XX.XX_and_Executed","NameList":["Agent_Status_Stopped"],"LevelList":["CRITICAL"],"StatusList":["Failed"],"EventTypeList":["Exception"],"Product":"ecs","CustomFilters":"Stopping"}]' --silence-time 86400 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms PutEventRule --region cn-hangzhou --SilenceTime 86400 --Description Event_alert_test --EventPattern.1.LevelList.1 CRITICAL --EventType SYSTEM --EventPattern.1.StatusList.1 Failed --EventPattern.1.Product ecs --EventPattern.1.NameList.1 Agent_Status_Stopped --GroupId 73780000 --EventPattern.1.EventTypeList.1 Exception --State ENABLED --EventPattern.1.SQLFilter '192.168.XX.XX_and_Executed' --EventPattern.1.CustomFilters Stopping --RuleName myRuleName
